note: Every outreach mail ever sent by the machine, so no address is ever mailed twice without a human deciding to. Appended by scripts/outreach_send.py. BACKFILL 2026-08-16: the duplicate guard only ever saw mail the machine sent, so the two licence asks Hidde sent by hand on 2026-08-08 (Woodland Trust, Catalonia) were invisible to it, and a batch built the same morning would have re-mailed the Woodland Trust eight days after his first ask with no reply yet. He caught it, not the script. Manual sends now belong in this file too; drafts/OUTREACH.md's table stays the human-readable log.
do_not_contact_note: Addresses and domains that asked not to be written to again, plus any we decide to leave alone. Checked by scripts/outreach_send.py before every send and never overridden, not even for a deliberate second batch. Add the whole domain as '@example.org' when an organisation asks as a whole. Added 2026-08-16: batches 003 and 004 promised in writing that a word would be enough, and nothing enforced it. First entry, 2026-08-16: info@haagsehofjes.nl is a biscuit company, not the almshouse foundation. Rogier Dop answered within the hour that trees are not his subject. Wrong target, so nothing about it improves with a better letter.
